title: 紅克里斯金銅礦
subcategoryTitleEn: Gold mines and deep underground systems
summary: 以加拿大金銅礦的露天及地下開發情境，分開資源、物流與公用系統假設。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A Canadian gold-copper case compares open-pit and underground-development scenarios with explicit resource, logistics and utility assumptions. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 不同開發情境的金屬產量基準；地下方案的高差能量而非設計證明；新增地下風路的分流假設
v31FocusEn: Metal-output bases across development scenarios; Underground-scenario elevation energy rather than design certification; Flow-sharing assumptions for added underground airways

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：紅克里斯金銅礦
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Red Chris gold-copper mine
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」與「地下方案的高差能量而非設計證明」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Metal-output bases across development scenarios" and "Underground-scenario elevation energy rather than design certification": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Metal-output bases across development scenarios" is correct?
options: 礦石噸數、品位與回收率是三個不同的量；乾基入料乘上金屬質量分率才是含金屬量，再乘回收率才是產品中的金屬。
精礦噸數增加一定代表金屬產量增加。
提升能源計算足以證明提升系統安全。
optionsEn: Ore tonnage, grade and recovery are different quantities.
More concentrate tonnes always mean more metal production.
An energy calculation is sufficient to prove a hoisting system safe.
quiz.explanation: 礦石噸數、品位與回收率是三個不同的量；乾基入料乘上金屬質量分率才是含金屬量，再乘回收率才是產品中的金屬。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ore tonnage, grade and recovery are different quantities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不同開發情境的金屬產量基準：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Metal-output bases across development scenarios: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」如何決定「紅克里斯金銅礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Metal-output bases across development scenarios” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Red Chris gold-copper mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「紅克里斯金銅礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」。礦石噸數、品位與回收率是三個不同的量；乾基入料乘上金屬質量分率才是含金屬量，再乘回收率才是產品中的金屬。先把採礦、選礦、精礦庫存各自畫成控制體，避免把運出量與當日生產量混用。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Red Chris gold-copper mine as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses metal-output bases across development scenarios. Ore tonnage, grade and recovery are different quantities. Dry feed multiplied by metal mass fraction gives contained metal, and applying recovery gives metal in product. Draw separate control volumes for mining, concentration and concentrate inventories so shipment and daily production are not confused. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」的模型 M = F·g·R / 10000，金屬量與回收守恆的合成教學算例；輸入單位：F: t dry ore/d; g: mass %; R: % recovery。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model M = F·g·R / 10000 for "Metal-output bases across development scenarios", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for contained metal and recovery balance; input units: F: t dry ore/d; g: mass %; R: % recovery. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: M = F·g·R / 10000；代入 F = 12000 t dry ore/d、g = 0.8 mass %、R = 85 % recovery，得 81.6 t/d（金屬量與回收守恆的合成教學算例；輸入單位：F: t dry ore/d; g: mass %; R: % recovery。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: M = F·g·R / 10000; with F = 12000 t dry ore/d, g = 0.8 mass %, R = 85 % recovery the result is 81.6 t/d (synthetic teaching example for contained metal and recovery balance; input units: F: t dry ore/d; g: mass %; R: % recovery. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 不同開發情境的金屬產量基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Metal-output bases across development scenarios: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Metal-output bases across development scenarios” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M = F·g·R / 10000；代入 F = 12000 t dry ore/d、g = 0.8 mass %、R = 85 % recovery，得 81.6 t/d（金屬量與回收守恆的合成教學算例；輸入單位：F: t dry ore/d; g: mass %; R: % recovery。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 g 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = F·g·R / 10000; with F = 12000 t dry ore/d, g = 0.8 mass %, R = 85 % recovery the result is 81.6 t/d (synthetic teaching example for contained metal and recovery balance; input units: F: t dry ore/d; g: mass %; R: % recovery. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise g by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：g 增加 10% 時，結果變為 89.8 t/d（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising g by 10% changes the result to 89.8 t/d (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 81.6 t/d（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 g 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 81.6 t/d (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in g with an engineering explanation.

These are not measured or operating values for this site.).

knowledge.text: g 增加 10% 時，結果變為 89.8 t/d（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising g by 10% changes the result to 89.8 t/d (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Metal-output bases across development scenarios"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」，使用合成的日入料、頭品位、精礦與尾礦資料，先閉合總質量再閉合金屬；列出取樣時間差造成的庫存變化。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For metal-output bases across development scenarios, use synthetic daily feed, head-grade, concentrate and tailings records.
quiz.explanation: 針對「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」，使用合成的日入料、頭品位、精礦與尾礦資料，先閉合總質量再閉合金屬；列出取樣時間差造成的庫存變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For metal-output bases across development scenarios, use synthetic daily feed, head-grade, concentrate and tailings records; close total mass before metal mass and list inventory changes caused by sampling-time differences. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不同開發情境的金屬產量基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Metal-output bases across development scenarios: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Metal-output bases across development scenarios” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」，使用合成的日入料、頭品位、精礦與尾礦資料，先閉合總質量再閉合金屬；列出取樣時間差造成的庫存變化。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For metal-output bases across development scenarios, use synthetic daily feed, head-grade, concentrate and tailings records; close total mass before metal mass and list inventory changes caused by sampling-time differences. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：報告同時列出乾基、濕基、金屬基與時間窗，任何數據缺口都以區間表示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Report dry, wet and contained-metal bases together with the time window, expressing missing data as intervals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」情境，產品金屬量偏低可能來自入料品位下降或選礦回收損失；比較尾礦品位與庫存校正後的平衡，不能只看產品噸數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of metal-output bases across development scenarios, low product metal may reflect falling feed grade or recovery loss; compare tailings assay and inventory-corrected balances rather than product tonnage alone. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Metal-output bases across development scenarios" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
提升能源計算足以證明提升系統安全。

Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
An energy calculation is sufficient to prove a hoisting system safe.

quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of metal-output bases across development scenarios, low product metal may reflect falling feed grade or recovery loss; compare tailings assay and inventory-corrected balances rather than product tonnage alone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 不同開發情境的金屬產量基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Metal-output bases across development scenarios: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Metal-output bases across development scenarios” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在「不同開發情境的金屬產量基準」情境，產品金屬量偏低可能來自入料品位下降或選礦回收損失；比較尾礦品位與庫存校正後的平衡，不能只看產品噸數。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「紅克里斯金銅礦」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: In the scenario of metal-output bases across development scenarios, low product metal may reflect falling feed grade or recovery loss; compare tailings assay and inventory-corrected balances rather than product tonnage alone. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Red Chris gold-copper mine”.

knowledge.text: 在「地下方案的高差能量而非設計證明」情境，單次能耗偏高可能是載荷估計錯誤或機械損失增加；比較空載基線與重載差值，不直接推斷制動性能。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of underground-scenario elevation energy rather than design certification, high energy per lift can reflect payload errors or added mechanical losses; compare empty and loaded baselines without inferring brake performance. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
